title: 溯源标签缺项与出口放行倒签压力
english: Missing traceability tag and pressure to backdate export records

modules.title: 发音热身
modules.hint: 慢速三遍、正常三遍，特别区分 provisional 与 final。
lines: Provisional release
临时放行
Traceability record
溯源记录
Export permit
出口许可证
Consignment
托运批次
Supporting evidence
支持证据
Reconciliation
核对一致
Authorized signatory
授权签字人

modules.title: 10高频词/短语
modules.hint: 先读英文，再遮住中文解释术语。
lines: Origin declaration
原产地声明
Chain-of-custody log
交接链日志
Mineral tag
矿产品标签
Export clearance
出口放行许可
Certificate validity
证书有效性
Document discrepancy
单证差异
Provisional invoice
暂定发票
Final settlement
最终结算
Independent verification
独立核验
Escalation protocol
升级处理程序

modules.title: 10核心句
modules.hint: 逐句跟读后不看文字重述。
lines: The export permit is valid, but the tag register is incomplete.
出口许可证有效，但标签登记册不完整。
Please identify the missing tags by lot number.
请按批次编号识别缺失的标签。
We cannot substitute an unverified origin statement.
我们不能用未经核验的原产地声明替代。
The shipment must remain segregated until reconciliation is complete.
核对完成前，货物必须隔离存放。
Please confirm who signed the custody transfer.
请确认谁签署了交接记录。
The buyer is asking for a release decision within thirty minutes.
买方要求三十分钟内决定是否放行。
A provisional invoice is not evidence of export clearance.
暂定发票不能证明已经获准出口。
We need a written response from the responsible compliance officer.
我们需要责任合规人员的书面回复。
Do not alter the original date or serial number.
不得修改原始日期或序列号。
We will communicate a revised dispatch time after verification.
核验后我们会通知新的发运时间。

modules.title: 数字金额吨位品位汇率
modules.hint: 全部为虚构教学数据。读数后计算净干重，口述单位。
lines: The shipment consists of twenty-four bags weighing one thousand two hundred kilograms each.
货物共24袋，每袋1200公斤。
The gross weight is twenty-eight point eight metric tonnes.
毛重为28.8公吨。
The moisture allowance is three point five percent.
水分扣减比例为3.5%。
The calculated dry weight is twenty-seven point seven nine two metric tonnes.
计算净干重为27.792公吨。
The illustrative tin grade is sixty-one point two percent.
模拟锡品位为61.2%。
The provisional price is eighteen thousand six hundred US dollars per dry tonne.
模拟暂定价格为每干吨18600美元。
The exercise exchange rate is one dollar to one thousand five hundred Rwandan francs.
练习汇率为1美元兑1500卢旺达法郎。
The sample payment amount is forty-two thousand US dollars.
模拟付款金额为42000美元。
Twenty-four tags are expected, but only twenty-three appear in the register.
应有24个标签，但登记册只有23个。

modules.title: Shadowing
modules.hint: 第一轮听读，第二轮同步跟读，第三轮录音复述。
lines: We have identified a missing tag entry during our pre-export reconciliation.
我们在出口前核对时发现缺少一条标签记录。
Although the physical bags are accounted for, the traceability evidence is not yet complete.
虽然实物袋数已核对，但溯源证据尚不完整。
We will hold dispatch, preserve the original records, and request written clearance.
我们将暂停发运、保留原始记录并申请书面放行。
We will not change the paperwork merely to meet a commercial deadline.
我们不会仅为满足商业期限而修改文件。

modules.title: Small Talk
modules.hint: 分别扮演采购方与物流方。
lines: Did your team complete the morning safety briefing?
你们团队完成早上的安全简报了吗？
Yes, everyone has signed the attendance sheet.
完成了，所有人都已在签到表签字。
How is the road to the border today?
今天去边境的路况如何？
Traffic is moving, but the checkpoint is busy.
交通正常，但检查点很繁忙。
Thanks. Let's review the documents before departure.
谢谢，我们出发前先核对单证。

modules.title: 矿业业务沟通
modules.hint: 压力点一：买方限时催货；压力点二：供应商要求先付款。回答需说明控制措施与替代时间表。
lines: Buyer: We need the truck released in thirty minutes or we will charge a delay penalty.
买方：三十分钟内必须放车，否则收取延误罚金。
Response: We understand the urgency, but traceability clearance is a release condition. We will provide a documented status update within twenty minutes.
示范：理解紧迫性，但溯源核验是放行条件。我们会在二十分钟内提供书面进度。
Supplier: Please pay the full balance now and resolve the tag issue later.
供应商：请现在支付全部尾款，标签问题以后解决。
Response: We can review any undisputed amount under the contract, but the disputed balance requires verified documents and approval.
示范：可按合同审核无争议金额，但争议尾款需要核实文件并完成审批。
Please reconcile bag IDs, tag numbers, weight tickets, and the assay lot reference.
请核对袋号、标签号、地磅单和化验批次编号。
No one may create a replacement record without a documented investigation.
没有书面调查记录，任何人不得补造替代记录。

modules.title: 运输押运/海关
modules.hint: 压力点三：代理建议倒签标签记录；练习明确拒绝。
lines: The escort officer must confirm the truck location and seal condition.
押运人员必须确认车辆位置和封签状态。
Keep the cargo in the approved secure holding area.
将货物存放在获准的安全暂存区。
Customs broker: We could backdate the missing tag entry to avoid a delay.
报关代理：可以倒签缺失标签记录以免延误。
Response: We cannot backdate or fabricate records. Please report the discrepancy and request the lawful correction procedure.
示范：不能倒签或伪造记录。请报告差异并申请合法更正程序。
Photograph the seal, the bag labels, and the signed handover sheet.
拍摄封签、袋子标签及签署的交接单。
Do not depart until the responsible authority confirms clearance in writing.
责任机构书面确认放行前不得出发。

modules.title: 15分钟高压角色扮演
modules.hint: 三轮各五分钟；每轮先自由作答，再朗读示范，最后换角色。
lines: Round one: The buyer threatens a penalty because one tag is missing from the register.
第一轮：买方因登记册缺少一个标签而威胁罚款。
Buyer: Your delay will disrupt our factory schedule. Release the shipment now.
买方：你们延误会打乱工厂计划，现在放货。
Manager: I recognize the cost of delay. However, we cannot release an incompletely documented shipment. I will send a written update within twenty minutes.
经理示范：理解延误成本，但不能放行单证不完整的货物。我会在二十分钟内提供书面更新。
Round two: A supplier demands full settlement before the discrepancy is resolved.
第二轮：供应商要求差异解决前全额结算。
Supplier: We delivered all twenty-four bags, so there is no reason to hold payment.
供应商：我们交付了24袋，没有理由扣款。
Finance: Physical delivery is confirmed, but the traceability record remains incomplete. We will review the contract and release only amounts that pass approval.
财务示范：实物交付已确认，但溯源记录不完整。我们将审查合同，仅支付审批通过的款项。
Round three: The broker suggests changing the document date to meet the export cut-off.
第三轮：代理建议修改文件日期赶出口截止时间。
Broker: Nobody will notice if we change the date to yesterday.
代理：把日期改成昨天没人会发现。
Compliance: We will not falsify the record. Preserve the original, document the discrepancy, and ask the authority for the proper amendment process.
合规示范：我们不会伪造记录。保留原件、记录差异，并向主管部门询问合规更正程序。

modules.title: 5句听写
modules.hint: 先只听音频并默写，再核对英文。
lines: One tag number is missing from the register.
登记册缺少一个标签号码。
Please preserve the original export documents.
请保留原始出口文件。
The shipment is on hold pending verification.
货物在核验前暂停放行。
We cannot backdate the handover record.
我们不能倒签交接记录。
The compliance officer will provide written clearance.
合规人员将提供书面放行确认。

modules.title: 5道口语题
modules.hint: 每题用英文回答45秒：结论、原因、行动、截止时间。
lines: How would you explain the difference between physical stock and traceability records?
如何解释实物库存与溯源记录的差别？
What would you tell a buyer who threatens a delay penalty?
买方威胁延误罚金时你会怎么说？
Which documents would you reconcile before export?
出口前你会核对哪些单证？
How would you respond to a request to backdate a record?
有人要求倒签记录时你会如何回应？
Under what conditions could an undisputed payment be reviewed?
什么条件下可以审核支付无争议款项？

modules.title: 前三课复习
modules.hint: 复习最近三课Day29至31；每句脱稿复述。
lines: A pricing deadline does not eliminate the need for an approved quotation.
点价截止时间不能免除报价审批。
Invoice and packing-list weights must be reconciled before export.
出口前必须核对发票与装箱单重量。
Consignee details must match the verified export documents.
收货人信息必须与已核验出口文件一致。
A bank payment hold requires documentary resolution, not verbal pressure.
银行付款暂停需要单证解决，不能靠口头施压。
Today we add traceability tags to the pre-release control checklist.
今天将溯源标签纳入放行前控制清单。

modules.title: 完整工作陈述
modules.hint: 完整读两遍，再在不看稿的情况下用90秒复述。
lines: Good morning. Our team completed the physical count of twenty-four mineral bags, but the tag register contains only twenty-three entries.
早上好。团队完成了24袋矿产品的实物清点，但标签登记册只有23条记录。
The export permit and the provisional invoice are available, yet the chain-of-custody evidence is incomplete.
出口许可证和暂定发票已经具备，但交接链证据尚不完整。
We have isolated the lot in the secure holding area and asked the escort officer to confirm the seal condition.
我们已将批次隔离存放在安全暂存区，并要求押运人员确认封签状态。
The buyer has requested immediate release and warned of a possible delay penalty.
买方要求立即放行，并警告可能产生延误罚金。
We recognize the commercial impact, but we will not alter or backdate any document.
我们理解商业影响，但不会修改或倒签任何文件。
Our logistics team is reconciling bag IDs, weight tickets, sample references, and tag records.
物流团队正在核对袋号、地磅单、样品编号及标签记录。
Finance will separately review the undisputed payment amount under the contract and approval policy.
财务将根据合同和审批政策单独审核无争议款项。
We will provide a written progress update within twenty minutes and a revised dispatch estimate after clearance.
我们将在二十分钟内提供书面进度，并在获准放行后更新预计发运时间。
No shipment will depart until the responsible authority confirms the appropriate release procedure.
责任机构确认适当放行程序前，任何货物都不会出发。
Thank you for your cooperation in protecting traceability, compliance, and our business relationship.
感谢配合，共同维护可追溯性、合规及业务关系。

Spend ten minutes on operations and transport decisions.
业务与运输决策10分钟。
Spend fifteen minutes on high-pressure role-play.
